subject.title: fix(agents): terminate mixed tool-call batches on critical loop veto

question: When a critical tool-loop veto terminates a run, must already-queued steering and follow-up messages be preserved for a fresh turn, or may the runtime discard them as part of the safety stop?
rationale: The patch intentionally drops queued input, which changes user-visible session semantics; source inspection cannot determine whether that loss is an accepted product contract.

options.title: Preserve queued input
options.body: Terminate provider execution immediately but retain or transfer pending steering and follow-up messages into the next safe turn, with regression coverage.

options.title: Accept safety-stop discard
options.body: Explicitly accept that a critical veto cancels queued input, document that contract, and add observable diagnostics so users know the messages were not processed.

recommendation.title: Preserve queued input
recommendation.body: Terminate provider execution immediately but retain or transfer pending steering and follow-up messages into the next safe turn, with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the recently internalized agent loop, session queue ordering, and sibling runtime contracts.
